claimReview.mounjaro: Known diarrhea and volume-depletion renal risk from August2026 label; no dose changes. NIDDK diet guidance rejects fasting/restrictive diet; ORS instructions follow packaging/professional advice. Red flags grounded in NHS.
claimReview.prolactin: MedlinePlus test is not cause diagnosis; ASRM2024 differential and macroprolactin; NIDDK benign tumor is only one cause. No food cure or individualized treatment. NHS supports urgent sudden severe headache/vision symptoms.
